Keep Your Vadodara Home Comfortable and Healthy

Are you tired of breathing in dusty air and feeling uncomfortable in your own home or office in Vadodara? Look no further than Atlas Aircon’s professional AC cleaning service. Our team of experts uses the latest technology to ensure your unit is running efficiently. Regular cleaning not only improves air quality but extends the life of your unit, helping you avoid costly repairs.

Why Choose Atlas Aircon?

  • 👨‍🔧 Expert Technicians: Highly trained professionals.
  • ❄️ Enhanced Cooling: Cools faster and more effectively.
  • 💰 Lower Bills: Consumes up to 30% less power.

  • 📈 Increased Lifespan: Prevents major breakdowns.
  • 🚀 Fast & Reliable: Quick service with minimal disruption.

📍 Serving Vadodara, Ahmedabad, Anand, Nadiad, Bharuch, Ankleshwar, Surat, and across Gujarat.

Common Issues Solved

  • AC not cooling enough: Jet Wash removes thick dust, restoring heat exchange.
  • Foul/musty smell: Chemical Wash eliminates mold and bacteria.
  • Water leaking inside: We thoroughly clean clogged drainpipes.
  • High electricity bills: Serviced ACs don’t work as hard, saving energy.
  • Noisy operation: Cleaning the blower motor reduces noise.

✅ Do’s

  • Schedule Annually: Service before summer.
  • Clean Filters: Every 1-2 months for airflow.
  • Keep Outdoor Clear: Free from leaves/dirt.
  • Check Noises: Call us for rattling/buzzing.

❌ Don’ts

  • Ignore Warning Signs: Reduced cooling needs attention.
  • DIY Complex Repairs: Avoid handling refrigerants.
  • Cover Unit While On: Ensure proper ventilation.
  • Postpone Service: Small issues become expensive.

Pros & Cons of Maintenance

Pros of Regular Cleaning: Improved air quality, better energy efficiency, extended lifespan, and enhanced performance.

Cons of Neglecting It: Health risks from allergens, higher utility costs, expensive system breakdowns, and poor comfort.

2

Using industry-standard techniques, we deep clean filters, coils, and vents.

Frequently Asked Questions

How often should I have my AC unit cleaned in Vadodara?
It is recommended at least once a year, especially before summer. Frequency depends on usage and local dust levels.
What are the signs that my AC unit needs cleaning?
Reduced airflow, unpleasant odors, increased energy bills, poor cooling, and water leakage.
Can AC cleaning improve energy efficiency?
Yes, a clean AC runs more efficiently, lowering energy consumption and your electricity bills.
Will AC cleaning help with my allergies?
Absolutely. It removes dust, pollen, mold, and other allergens, significantly improving indoor air quality.
